title: Partition Viewer

The provider owns the key and ribbon state; the document surface is * visible JSX. */ export function PartitionViewerBlock() { const source = { kind: "url" as const, url: PDF_URL, fileName: "an-image-is-worth-16x16-words.pdf", } return (
